about:
About Know The Company

Know The Company is an open review platform for startups and growing companies, everywhere. Big brands already have thousands of reviews; the companies people actually hire, work with and work for often have none. Anyone can read and write reviews for free. We show how a company treats both its customers and its employees.

Our mission and how we work

Our mission

Honest information before you pay

Customers deserve to know how a company treats people before they hand over money or personal data.

How we earn

Companies pay for tools, not stars

Basic listings are free for the first year for companies that join before 31 March 2027, then ₹499 a year. Plus costs ₹999 a year. A listing gives a business tools, and never changes its rating.

Who we serve

Startups and growing companies worldwide

From a two-person studio to a 500-person scale-up, every company can be listed and reviewed.

What we stand for

NeutralPaid and unpaid companies are reviewed and moderated the same way.TransparentWe publish how many reviews we remove and why.Real peopleReviewers confirm their email before they can post.Fair to companiesEvery company can reply publicly and report reviews that break our rules. help:
Answers for reviewers, employees and companies.

For reviewers

Is Know The Company free for reviewers?

Yes. Reading and writing reviews is always free.

Why do I need to log in to post?

Logging in with a one-time code confirms you are a real person and lets you see and manage your reviews.

Can I edit or remove my review?

Yes. Open My reviews after logging in and remove a review you wrote.

Why was my review removed?

Only reviews that break our review guidelines, or that we must remove by law, are taken down. We email you the reason.

For employees

Can I post an employee review anonymously?

Yes. You choose for each review: anonymous, or with your name. Your email is never shown, and your employer can't see who wrote an anonymous review.

How do you verify employees?

Log in with your work email at the company's website domain to get a “Work email verified” badge.

Can my employer remove my review?

No. We remove a review only when it breaks our guidelines or we receive a valid legal order.

What should I not include?

Names of junior colleagues, confidential company information or trade secrets, and accusations you can't back up with evidence.

For employers

What does a verified listing include?

Basic includes a verified badge, an employer branding page, city and category pages, replies to reviews and a review link. It is free for your first year if you join before 31 March 2027, then ₹499 a year. Plus (₹999 a year) adds call, WhatsApp and email buttons, photos, and offers and updates.

Do I need to pay?

Not in your first year. Companies that join before 31 March 2027 get Basic free for their first year. After that, listings cost ₹499 a year by yearly autopay, which you set up only if you want to continue. You can cancel autopay at any time.

Can I post jobs?

Job posts are coming soon. For now, Know The Company focuses on customer and employee reviews. Verified businesses will be the first to post jobs when they launch.

Can I get a refund?

Yes. If you pay for a plan and change your mind within 14 days, write to knowthecompanysupport@gmail.com for a full refund. If we can’t verify your company, we refund you in full. See our refunds and cancellations policy.

Can paying remove bad reviews?

No. Payment never changes ratings or hides reviews. You can reply publicly or report reviews that break the rules.

My company is already listed. What now?

Open your profile and press Claim. You keep the existing reviews.

Trust and safety

How do you stop fake reviews?

We confirm reviewers by email, check for patterns such as many reviews from one device, and review flagged content by hand.

How do I report a review?

Use Report on the review, or contact us with a link to it. Companies can also report from their dashboard.

Still need help?

Contact us
guidelines:
The rules that keep reviews useful for everyone.

How we list companies

Well-known startups are added from public information (name, website, category, country) so people can review them. Other companies are added by their owners, or by reviewers who have worked with them. These profiles are marked “Unclaimed” and show no rating until real customers review them. A listed company is never presented as a partner or customer of Know The Company.

Writing a review

Write about your own experience in the last 12 months. No hate speech, personal data about staff, or claims of crime without evidence. Reviews in exchange for money, discounts or gifts are not allowed.

Reviews companies bring with them

Companies on the Plus plan can send us reviews they collected before joining, from their own website, emails, surveys or other review sites. We contact every reviewer to confirm they wrote the review and agree to it appearing here, and we publish nothing we can't confirm. Companies must send all the reviews they have, not only the good ones. Imported reviews are labelled "Imported" and show where and when they were first given.

When a review goes live

Reviews are published as soon as they are posted. Our team reads new reviews and reports, and takes down any review that breaks these guidelines. Anyone can report a review they think breaks them.

Employee reviews

Write only about your own time at the company as an employee, contractor or intern. Don't name junior colleagues or identify anyone other than senior leaders. Don't share confidential company information or trade secrets, and don't make accusations you can't back up. Employers can't remove employee reviews. You choose whether each employee review is anonymous or shows your name. We never show your email, and we share an anonymous reviewer's identity only when a valid court order requires it.

What companies can and can't do

Companies can reply publicly, invite customers to review, and report reviews that break these rules. When they invite reviews, they must invite all their customers, not only the happy ones. They can't edit, hide or delay reviews, and paying for a listing never changes ratings.

When we remove a review

Only when it breaks these guidelines or we receive a valid legal order.

Last updated: 10 November 2026

These terms apply to everyone who uses Know The Company, operated by Kautilya Upadhyay. By using the site you agree to them.

1. Accounts

  • You must be at least 18 to create an account.
  • Keep your login email secure. You are responsible for activity on your account.
  • Reviewer and company accounts are separate. Company accounts cannot post reviews.
  • An account that has written reviews cannot claim or manage a company. To manage a company, delete your reviewer account first and use a separate account.
  • Reviews written by an account that manages a company are not shown and do not count towards any rating, including reviews written before the account became a company account.

2. Writing reviews

  • Reviews must describe your own genuine experience in the last 12 months.
  • Do not post reviews in exchange for money, discounts or gifts, or reviews about your own business or a competitor.
  • Do not include personal data about others, hate speech, threats, or claims of crime without evidence.
  • You keep ownership of your review and give Know The Company a licence to display and distribute it.

3. Employee reviews

  • Post only your own experience as an employee, contractor or intern.
  • Do not share confidential information or trade secrets.
  • Do not name or identify individual people, other than senior leaders such as directors and executives.
  • Employers cannot remove employee reviews. We remove them only when they break these terms or the law requires it.
  • We keep your identity private and disclose it only when a valid court order requires us to.

4. Business listings

  • Companies that join before 31 March 2027 get their verified Basic listing free for 12 months from the day it is created. After that, and for companies that join later, Basic costs ₹499 a year in India, or $9 a year outside India.
  • Plus costs ₹999 a year in India, or $19 a year outside India, with a 30-day free trial. It adds profile features only. If Plus is cancelled, the profile moves to Basic when the year you paid for ends.
  • Paid plans renew every year by autopay on the card, UPI or bank mandate you used, until you cancel. For Indian cards, UPI and bank mandates, your bank or payment app notifies you at least 24 hours before each renewal charge.
  • You can cancel autopay at any time. No further charges are made, and your plan stays active until the end of the year you paid for.
  • A free period never turns into a charge unless you set up autopay. If a plan ends, your profile stays on the site as an unclaimed profile and keeps its reviews.
  • A verified listing, free or paid, gives verification, a profile and tools. It never affects ratings, review order or moderation.
  • Job posts are not available yet. When they launch, these terms will be updated before any business can post.
  • We may suspend a listing that gives false information or tries to manipulate reviews.
  • Payments are processed by our payment partner. We never see or store your full card or bank details.
  • Refunds: if you pay for a plan and change your mind within 14 days, write to us for a full refund. After that, fees for the current year are not refundable, except where the law requires. Our refunds and cancellations policy has the full details.

5. Moderation

We remove content that breaks these terms or our review guidelines, or when required by law.

6. Liability

Reviews are the opinions of their authors, not of Know The Company. To the extent the law allows, Know The Company is not liable for decisions you make based on reviews.

7. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India, and Indian courts have jurisdiction, unless your local consumer law gives you other rights.

8. Contact

  • Know The Company is run by Kautilya Upadhyay, Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India.
  • Questions about these terms: knowthecompanysupport@gmail.com.
  • Complaints about content on the site go to our grievance officer, Nimish Chhabra, at knowthecompanysupport@gmail.com. We acknowledge complaints within 24 hours and resolve them within 7 days.
privacy:
Last updated: 10 November 2026

This policy explains what personal data Know The Company collects when you use Know The Company, why, and your choices.

What we collect

  • Account details: your name and email address.
  • Content you post: reviews, replies, reports and messages.
  • Proof files you upload to verify a review. We delete these after checking them.
  • Work email addresses used to verify employee reviews. We never show them to employers or the public.
  • Business listing details and payment confirmations. Payment details are handled by our payment provider, not stored by us.
  • Basic technical data such as device type and pages visited, to keep the site secure.

How we use it

  • To run your account and show your reviews with your chosen name.
  • To detect fake reviews and abuse.
  • To verify businesses and process listing payments.
  • To reply to your messages and send login codes.

What we never do

We never sell your personal data or show reviewers' email addresses to businesses.

Sharing

We share data only with service providers who help us run Know The Company (hosting, email, payments), and when required by law, such as a valid court order.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you can ask to access, correct or delete your data, and withdraw consent. Write to knowthecompanysupport@gmail.com and we will reply within the time the law requires. You can also ask us to delete your account from the My reviews page.

Cookies and storage

We use essential storage to keep you logged in and remember preferences. We use privacy-friendly analytics that count visits without following you across other sites.

Contact

Privacy questions: knowthecompanysupport@gmail.com. Grievance officer: Nimish Chhabra, knowthecompanysupport@gmail.com.

Last updated: 10 November 2026

This policy covers the paid listing plans on Know The Company, run by Kautilya Upadhyay. Reading and writing reviews is free, so none of this applies to reviewers.

1. What you pay for

  • Basic listing: ₹499 a year in India, or $9 a year outside India. Plus listing: ₹999 a year in India, or $19 a year outside India.
  • Each plan runs for one year from the day it starts and renews every year by autopay until you cancel. Current prices are always on our pricing page.
  • A listing is a digital service. Nothing is shipped to you.

2. How the service is delivered

  • Your listing tools switch on as soon as we verify that you represent the company. We email you when the listing is live.
  • If we can’t verify your company, we cancel the order and refund the full amount.

3. Free periods

  • Companies that join before 31 March 2027 get Basic free for their first year, and Plus starts with 30 days free.
  • You are never charged at the end of a free period unless you set up autopay. We email you before it ends.

4. Autopay and cancelling

  • Paid plans renew every year by autopay on the card, UPI or bank mandate you used. For Indian cards, UPI and bank mandates, your bank or payment app notifies you at least 24 hours before each renewal charge.
  • You can cancel autopay at any time, by writing to knowthecompanysupport@gmail.com from the email address on your listing, or by cancelling the mandate in your UPI app or with your bank.
  • When you cancel, no further charges are made and your tools stay active until the end of the year you paid for.
  • If a plan ends, your profile stays on the site as an unclaimed profile and keeps its reviews.

5. Refunds

  • Change your mind within 14 days of paying, and we refund the full amount. No reason is needed.
  • After 14 days, fees for the current year are not refundable, except where the law requires a refund.
  • If you were charged twice, or charged for an order that failed, we refund the extra amount in full.
  • If we suspend a listing because it broke our terms, for example by trying to manipulate reviews, the fee is not refunded.

6. How refunds are paid

  • Refunds go back to the payment method you used. We start the refund within 5 working days of approving it.
  • Your bank or card provider may take another 5 to 7 working days to show it in your account.

7. Refunds never affect reviews

Paying, cancelling or getting a refund never changes a company’s ratings, review order or moderation, and cancelling never removes reviews.

8. Contact

  • Refund and cancellation requests: knowthecompanysupport@gmail.com. Include your company name and the date you paid.
  • Address: Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India.
  • If you are not happy with how we handled your request, write to our grievance officer, Nimish Chhabra, at knowthecompanysupport@gmail.com.

Show up when people ask AI about you

More people now ask AI assistants “Is this a good company to work with?” instead of searching. These tools rely heavily on independent sources, like review sites, rather than a company's own website.

Your Verified badge shows we confirmed you control the company’s email or website, or checked official documents. That matters when fake job offers and copycat sites are everywhere.

Getting started

1

Claim your page

Add your details and story. Free for your first year.

2

Invite people

Straight answers

Before you sign up

Will this guarantee we appear in Google or AI answers?

No one can guarantee that, and you should be wary of anyone who does. What we do is give search engines and AI tools a complete, verified page with independent reviews, which is the kind of source they tend to rely on.

Does the link on our page help our SEO?

Links from company pages follow Google’s rules for paid and user-generated links, so they don’t pass ranking. They do send real visitors to your site, and your page itself can show up for searches about your company.

We have no reviews yet. Is it still worth it?

Yes. Your verified page, description and employer page work from day one, and your review links help you collect the first reviews quickly.

Can we pay to improve our rating?

Never. Plans add tools, not stars. That rule is the reason customers, job seekers and AI tools can trust your rating.

Our neutrality pledge

Fair questions

What employers ask us

Can we see who wrote an employee review?

No, not when it is anonymous. Each employee chooses to post anonymously or with their name. We share an anonymous reviewer’s identity only when a valid court order requires it.

Can we ask our employees to write reviews?

Yes. Share your employee review link with the whole team, not only people you expect to be positive. Don’t offer rewards for reviews or ask to see them first. Invited reviews are labelled.

How do the Employees’ Choice awards work?

Winners are chosen only from employee ratings. You can’t apply or pay. A company needs at least 10 employee reviews in the year and no sign of review manipulation. The first awards are planned for 2027.

We already have Google reviews. Why add this?

Keep both. Google is great for maps and directions. Know The Company adds employee reviews next to customer reviews, and a page you can link to from your website, Instagram and WhatsApp.

What if someone posts a bad review?

Reply publicly with your side, calmly and with facts. If it breaks our guidelines, report it and we check it. We never remove reviews just because they are negative, and an honest reply often wins more trust than a perfect score.

Does this help if the site is new?

Yes. Your page link and review link work wherever your customers already are: your website, careers page, LinkedIn, proposals and email signature. Visitors from our site come on top of that as it grows.

What’s the difference between Basic and Plus?

Basic gives you a verified profile with a link to your website, replies to reviews and an employer page. Plus (₹999 a year) adds call, WhatsApp and email buttons, a photo gallery, offers and updates and no competitor suggestions on your profile. Both plans are reviewed and rated exactly the same way.

Is it really free?

Yes. Companies that join before 31 March 2027 get Basic free for their first year. After that, the listing costs ₹499 a year by yearly autopay, which you set up only if you want to continue. You can cancel autopay at any time.

Will a verified listing improve my rating?

No. Ratings come only from reviews. Verified and unverified companies are reviewed and moderated the same way.

Can I remove a bad review?

No, but you can reply publicly, and report a review that breaks our guidelines so our team can check it.

How does the website link help me?

Customers reading your reviews can visit your site in one click from your verified profile. Links on profiles are marked nofollow or sponsored, as search engines require, so the value is real visitors rather than search ranking.

What is the employer branding page?

A “Work at” section on your profile where you show why people should join you: benefits, team size, open roles and photos. It sits beside your employee reviews and never changes your ratings.

Can I post jobs?

Job posts are coming soon. For now, Know The Company focuses on customer and employee reviews. Verified businesses will be the first to post jobs when they launch.

Can I switch plans?

Yes. Upgrade to Plus at any time from your dashboard, with 30 days free. If you cancel Plus, your profile moves to Basic when the year you paid for ends, and keeps all its reviews.

Can companies in any country join?

Yes. Companies anywhere can list, and Basic is free for the first year.
